_comment: Per-provider probe targets for src/doctor.js (issue #110). egressHosts, loginUrl, and loginSelector are derived from the israeli-bank-scrapers scraper sources (lib/scrapers/*.js) and must be revisited when the pinned library version changes. loginSelector is the element the library's own login flow waits for; null means the login page is an API-driven SPA with no stable pre-login selector, so L2 falls back to 'reached a real page, not a WAF block'. blockMarkers are appended to the shared defaults in doctor.js.
